name: ValidateConstraints
description: Check that the constraint text parses and that the concepts, attributes, pointers, and sets it names are in the META.

configStructure.name: scope
configStructure.description: The concept named on the constraint set. ROOT is the project-wide scope and is not looked up as a concept. When empty, the scope stored with the constraints is used.

configStructure.name: text
configStructure.description: Constraint text to check. When empty, the constraints registry on the project root is used.
